title: Nook Works Master → Detail Interaction Prototype
summary: v2 以 Synthetic Business Object 研究 General Detail Pattern、固定 Audit sub-pattern，以及 Query → Detail → Return 時以 stable record identity 在變動中的 current result set 重新定位工作上下文。
flow: Paginated Query → Stable Record Selection → General Detail → Result-set Change → Record Re-location → Return Context
